_meta.title: Beverly tax-exempt property and PILOT analysis
_meta.source: MassGIS Level 3 standardized parcel data, Beverly (M030), CY2025/FY2026 assessment (M030Assess table). Foregone-tax figures computed at the FY25 residential rate.
_meta.taxRateNote: FY25 residential rate, single-rate community. Confirm FY26 certified rate before publication; foregone-tax figures scale linearly with it.
_meta.notes: Exempt = state use codes 900-999. PILOT-eligible universe = private education + charitable/hospital (940-959), excluding government, city, and housing-authority parcels.

totals.currentPilotNote: Budget book $250K; forecast lists $255K. Either way it is ~12% of Endicott's foregone tax alone.

institutions.note: Owner-level totals from the parcel file. foregoneTax = assessed x 10.99 / 1000.

list.owner: Beverly Hospital (Northeast Hospital Corp / Beth Israel Lahey)

pilotScenarios.note: Applied to the $451.6M PILOT-eligible universe. Boston's model is 25% of assessed-equivalent, half creditable as community benefits, so ~12.5% effective cash. Multi-year negotiation timeline.
